Enum Class CANAPITypes.CANDeviceType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CANAPITypes.CANDeviceType>
org.wpilib.hardware.hal.CANAPITypes.CANDeviceType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CANAPITypes.CANDeviceType>, Constable
Enclosing class:
CANAPITypes
public static enum CANAPITypes.CANDeviceType extends Enum<CANAPITypes.CANDeviceType>
FIRST CAN device type.

This enum represents different types of CAN devices. Teams are encouraged to use the MISCELLANEOUS for custom or miscellaneous devices.

See Also:
